a.lede: Today is Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday, with security updates addressing a record-breaking 1,411 flaws, including one actively exploited and two publicly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities. [...]
a.title: Microsoft October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,411 flaws, 3 zero-days

b.lede: This month’s update also marks the first official one for Windows 11 26H2 and the end of support for Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro.
b.title: Windows update patches a whopping 1,400 security bugs – including 2 zero days
